title: AdvancedKitPlus
description:
AdvancedKitPlus Ultimate GUI Kit v1.0
The ultimate GUI based kit management solution. Go beyond basic kits with a full in game editor
body:
AdvancedKitPlus | The Ultimate GUI Kit Plugin
Powerful, GUI-driven kit management for modern Minecraft servers.

Ditch the YAML files and outdated kit systems. AdvancedKitPlus is a fully GUI-based, MySQL-ready solution for creating, managing, and delivering kits in a polished and professional way. Perfect for both casual SMPs and large-scale networks.

Demo 

<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/Jm3Bd9RH_KA" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

✨ Why AdvancedKitPlus?

Admin Friendly: Use /akit edit for full control in a sleek in-game GUI—no file editing required.
Player Focused: Smooth GUI, preview system, sound feedback, and auto-equip for armor slots.
Scalable & Flexible: Lock kits behind playtime, world restrictions, money, XP levels, and more.
Integrated Features: Kit vouchers, one-time kits, custom commands, MySQL support.


<details>
<summary>Spoiler | Advanced Kit Conditions</summary>

• Restrict kits by level, playtime, money, or world
• Add commands to kits (ranks, effects, rewards, etc.)
• Create one-time kits or physical vouchers for events

</details>


<details>
<summary>Spoiler | Gui Management</summary>

• Browse, edit, and create kits directly in-game
• Customize icons, categories, prices, cooldowns, and more
• Live item picker & per-kit hologram editor

</details>


<details>
<summary>Spoiler | Player Experience</summary>

• Kit preview menu
• First join kits
• Auto-equip armor
• Fully translatable
• Sound effects for polish

</details>


🔌 Requirements
• Vault – For economy features
• PlaceholderAPI – For playtime & placeholders
• Economy plugin – (e.g., EssentialsX)
